The generating function u^r z^w C(z,u)^2 and derivative give exact first mixed moments. Explicit coefficients and the binomial mean of the part count yield the stated piecewise identity; a complete four-case integer sign analysis and conditional part-count argument prove the zero classifications. A standalone exhaustive finite checker passed 24,558 exact arithmetic assertions through composition size 12. Infinite ranges follow from algebra, not enumeration.

value.rationale: Dependence between a global complexity count (total parts) and local exact-word occurrences is a natural statistic in uniform random compositions. The universal collapse to just length and weight, despite radically different autocorrelations of words, is a structural identity. It yields a complete sharp sign and zero diagram, proves both covariance-zero cases remain dependent, and isolates a family of nonzero covariance constants independent of sample size; these go beyond routine first-moment enumeration.
